bash: cd /app
echo "########## idempotency: re-run setup ##########"
sh srv-shared-acl/setup.sh; echo "rerun exit=$?"
sh srv-shared-acl/verify.sh >/tmp/v2.log 2>&1; echo "verify after rerun exit=$?"; tail -2 /tmp/v2.log

echo
echo "########## BREAK 1: strip default ACL (inheritance gone) ##########"
setfacl -k /srv/shared
sh srv-shared-acl/verify.sh 2>&1 | grep -c '^FAIL'
sh srv-shared-acl/verify.sh 2>&1 | grep '^FAIL' | head -8

echo
echo "########## BREAK 2: drop mask to r-- (alice/bob capped) ##########"
sh srv-shared-acl/setup.sh
setfacl -m m::r-- /srv/shared
sh srv-shared-acl/verify.sh 2>&1 | grep '^FAIL' | head -8

echo
echo "########## BREAK 3: open to others ##########"
sh srv-shared-acl/setup.sh
chmod o+rx /srv/shared
sh srv-shared-acl/verify.sh 2>&1 | grep '^FAIL' | head -5
